description: List calendar training targets in a date range. Requires training_targets:read.

after.description: Inclusive start date. Serialized as a Polar date or date-time according to the endpoint contract.

all_pages.description: Fetch multiple pages up to max_pages.

before.description: Exclusive end date. Serialized as a Polar date or date-time according to the endpoint contract.

explicit_user_intent.description: Required true when privacy_mode=raw or include_gps=true (agent escalation of redaction).

features.description: Optional Polar v4 feature flags. Values are validated per endpoint; feature ranges that require one day are hydrated safely.

limit.description: Local page-size hint used for pagination safety.

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch when all_pages is true.

privacy_mode.description: Optional per-call privacy override. Defaults to POLAR_PRIVACY_MODE or structured. raw returns upstream Polar JSON. summary removes GPS/map details.

name: polar_list_training_targets
title: Polar Training Targets
